status: PROVISIONAL - all ratio, threshold and clamp values in this file are calibration candidates, not final production values

reference.note: 4K60 reference configuration. The base profiles in svtav1.json are tuned for this. Scaling factors are computed relative to these values.

classification.note: Metadata-only source-efficiency indicator (identical scheme to x265_scaling.json).

param_rules._comment: Modes: fixed (default for anything not listed), fps (FR* expressions evaluated against source fps). keyint/lookahead are FR*-based; everything else stays fixed (crf/tune/aq/... are intentionally never scaled).

keyint.note: FR*10 = 10s GOP; capped at 600 frames to bound seek granularity/memory at >60fps sources.

lookahead.note: FR*2 lookahead; cap bounds SVT-AV1 lookahead memory at high-FPS sources.

dynamic_vbv._comment: mbr_kbps = clamp(OB * target_ratio, OB * min_ratio, OB * max_ratio). OB = original container bitrate in kbps. CRF remains the primary quality control; mbr is the capped-CRF bitrate ceiling (translation of x265 CRF+VBV). Missing class entry falls back to the static base-profile vbv_maxrate. bufsize_factor has no SVT-AV1 equivalent (no VBV buffer parameter) and is ignored.
